law.catch_line: Persons by whom alcoholic beverages may not be sold or served for on-premises consumption; penalty
law.text: No person shall permit anyone employed by him under the age of (i) eighteen years to sell, serve or dispense in any manner alcoholic beverages for on-premises consumption, except pursuant to subdivisions 1 through 5 of § 4.1-200 or (ii) twenty-one years to prepare or mix alcoholic beverages in the capacity of bartender. Any person convicted of a violation of this section shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
